_about: The standard structure of the GHL affiliate program: every custom field (name, type, options in order), tag, pipeline (stages in order), the Partner Intro Call calendar, and the names of the 8 workflows and 3 forms. Recovered from the first build (Sep 21-22 2026) over the API.

tools/ghl/build-structure.js, double-check.js and survey.js read this file. tools/ghl/structure.default.json is the fallback copy: tools/ghl/selftest.js fails when the two differ in any name, type, option, stage, calendar setting, workflow or form.

A client config (clients/<CLIENT_SLUG>/config.json) applies its changes on top, under "structure": the same name replaces an entry, a new name adds one, and "remove" drops names. See process/3-structure.md.

Always client-specific, set in the client config: the Partner Type options (the build refuses to run while they are empty), the segment/ tags, and the calendar slug and description. The first build also added one Lost Reason option ("Already has an SEO partner") through its config.

"key" on a field is the merge-field key GHL derives from the name (for example contact.referral_code, used as {{contact.referral_code}}). The scripts do not send it: GHL makes it. "note" is for people; the scripts ignore it.
dataType values are GHL API names: TEXT (single line), LARGE_TEXT (multi-line), NUMERICAL, MONETORY (GHL spelling), SINGLE_OPTIONS (dropdown), DATE.

The calendar hours (Mon and Tue 10:00-17:00, the account time zone), the owner (calendarOwnerUserId = <PLACEHOLDER_USER>) and the empty meeting link are placeholders until the client sets them in process/9-handover.md.
Workflows and forms are built in the GHL UI (spec/forms.md, spec/workflows/). Their names are listed here so double-check.js and survey.js --ids can find them.

calendar._note: Set over the API by build-structure.js. Seen in the first build and left at GHL defaults (not sent): eventType RoundRobin_OptimizeForAvailability, preBuffer 0, allowBookingFor counts calendar days, googleInvitationEmails on, the thank-you message and consent label GHL writes, no notifications, isZoomAdded false, an empty custom meeting location. openHours must hold one entry per day: several days in one entry is refused (422).
calendar.name: Partner Intro Call
calendar.description: A 20-minute intro call with a prospective referral partner.
